case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4983 OF 2009; WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4988 OF 2009; WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4984 OF 2009; WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4985 OF 2009; WITH CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 165-168 OF 2007; WITH CIVIL APPEAL NO. 4989-4992 OF 2009

parties.respondent: Ravi Kumar (Deceased) through LRs and others

summary: Dispute over ownership of 183 bigha 8 biswa land; 1924 lease deed with restrictive covenants; subsequent sale in 1947; tenant claims under tenancy laws; 1967 eviction suit stayed by UP Public Premises Act exemption for tenure-holders; upheld on technical grounds; mutation proceedings initiated in 1978; confirmed through successive revenue authorities; partition formalized in 1981; challenges to revenue mutations dismissed by Board of Revenue; State's claims on original title overruled by continuous revenue recognition of tenancy rights; final determination on continuous possession and revenue entries.
legal_provisions_cited: UP Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorised Occupants) Act, 1972
final_judgment: State's claims dismissed; ownership confirmed in favor of respondents based on mutation entries and revenue records; all appeals rejected.
